summary: Pyrophyte Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, disclosed an October 14, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with Sakuu Corporation, a Delaware battery-technology company, and Merger Sub. Pyrophyte will domesticate to Delaware, rename itself Sakuu Holdings, Inc., then merge Merger Sub into Sakuu, leaving Sakuu a wholly owned subsidiary. Pre-closing Class A and Class B shares convert one-for-one; no price per share, premium, exchange ratio or break fee is stated. The filing names no advisor. Watch redemption levels, PIPE financing, and the proxy/extension timeline as key deal-completion risks.
